title: Developer Orientation Microcanvas — credential & streaming microassets
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding microassets for the API/SDK docs focused on: credential flows (API key rotate, device code), streaming UX (progressive tokens & timeline overlays), and tool-calling states (permission banners, tool result cards). Deliverables are annotated screenshots, motion specs for streaming responses, a sprite sheet for code-snippet variants, and accessibility alt-text for each export. Goal: reduce first-time integration confusion and support the docs release scheduled for docs-2026.02.
acceptance_criteria: Primary API onboarding flow has three annotated screen variants exported as PNG @2x (credential, streaming, toolcall)
Motion specs included with frame timings and easing (Figma prototype link validated)
Figma tokens synced with design system and QA-checked against current console palette
All images and snippets include alt-text and keyboard-accessible descriptions for docs team
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in PR; PM and Eng sign-off obtained before merge
